description: Removes units of a purchased product from a user; it cannot be undone here. It moves no money and is not a refund (neblla_sales). Fails with insufficient_amount when the user has fewer. The user's app hears a live `purchase` event. More: neblla_get_llms tools/consume_purchase

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

productName.description: The product's id or the name the app's code uses.

name: neblla_consume_purchase
title: Spend a user's purchased units
